hints.title: Thief Distances
hints.text: Start with a multi-source breadth-first search from all thieves to compute the Manhattan distance from each cell to the closest thief.

hints.title: Binary Search on Safeness
hints.text: The safeness factor ranges between 0 and 2 * n. Binary search on the answer k to see if a valid path exists.

hints.title: Reachability Validation
hints.text: For a candidate safeness k, check via breadth-first search if there is a connected path from top-left to bottom-right using only cells with distance at least k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Multi-source BFS for thief distances followed by binary search path verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all simple paths from top-left to bottom-right is exponential in grid area.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) auxiliary matrix for distances and BFS traversal queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into multi-source distance labeling followed by monotonic binary search.
